aum_average: not printed in the managing company report

pension_veteran: the company does not manage veteran pension funds in this report; its two pension funds are new funds (comprehensive + general)
Blank cells in the summary tables (for example no one-time deposits in a fund type) are not facts
notes: Source: financial statements and directors report of the managing company (מנורה מבטחים פנסיה וגמל בע"מ - חברה מנהלת), published on the company website (menoramivt.co.il, pension-and-gemel reports page; file name starts with ממפג). The listed parent (מנורה מבטחים החזקות) was not used for any figure.
Units: NIS thousand unless the fact says otherwise (members: count; fee rates: percent; per-fact unit field).

Extra fact fields beyond the spec: "component" = the fund type or segment column as printed (comprehensive pension fund, general pension fund, study funds, savings and severance funds, other, guaranteed-return tracks, investment gemel, child gemel); "population" = active / inactive / benefit recipients / total where the table splits by it. segment=pension_new covers two funds (comprehensive and general) as separate components; segment=provident covers all gemel-type columns as separate components; nothing is summed in this file. The company-total column is segment=total, component="סך הכל החברה".

Windows: the report tables are cumulative (Q1 report: Jan-Mar = window q; Q2 report: Jan-Jun = ytd; Q3 report: Jan-Sep = ytd; annual report: fy). Three-month figures for Q2 and Q3 exist only in the segment note (management fees, expenses, profit before tax); Q2-only and Q3-only flows (deposits, transfers) are not printed.
Instant facts (members, aum): date = balance date of each printed column; flow facts: date = period end.

AUM: summary-table AUM is split active / inactive / benefit recipients (population field). Track-table totals (population starting with סה"כ) come from the directors report analysis section and are the full fund balances including pensioners and benefit recipients; for the two pension funds the summary-table sum and the track-table total differ.

Segment note: pension = management of pension funds (comprehensive + general), net management fees as printed; provident ("ניהול קופות גמל") = gemel and study funds; guaranteed-return tracks are a separate segment column whose revenue is investment gain, not management fees, kept as provident with a separate component. Parentheses in the tables mean negative; values are stored with sign. Items marked * in comparatives were reclassified by the company (fact note).

selling_and_marketing_expenses = "עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות"; no deferred acquisition cost amortisation is separately printed for the managing company. finance_expenses, intangible_amortisation and gains_credited_to_guaranteed_track_members are extra metrics for lines printed in the segment note.
Not copied into the file: payments to pensioners, actuarial surplus, direct investment expense rates, disconnected-accounts tables, and the solo appendix (duplicates the segment note).
